sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首了，体内血液已被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来她的凶手费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是Casefile Presents推出的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: Clock on the morning of Friday, October 2, 1987, police officers in the small Kentucky town of Central City received a call that they needed to head out to a possible crime scene
sentences.zh: 1987年10月2日，星期五清晨，肯塔基州小镇森特勒尔城的警官们接到一通电话，称他们需要前往一个可能的犯罪现场

sentences.en: a few blocks away.
sentences.zh: 几个街区外。

sentences.en: An employee of the town's municipal department, located on Legion Drive, had noticed something strange upon arriving at work.
sentences.zh: 镇市政部门的一名员工在上班时注意到了一件奇怪的事情，该部门位于军团大道。

sentences.en: Parked haphazardly behind the department's garage, was a battered 1977 Pontiac that looked very out of place.
sentences.zh: 部门车库后面杂乱无章地停着一辆破旧的1977年庞蒂亚克汽车，显得格格不入。

sentences.en: The employee had gone up to the seemingly abandoned car to get a closer look.
sentences.zh: 这名员工走到那辆看似被遗弃的汽车前仔细查看。

sentences.en: What he discovered led him to contact the police.
sentences.zh: 他的发现促使他联系了警方。

sentences.en: Lieutenant Billy Fields rushed to the scene and was the first responder to arrive.
sentences.zh: 比利·菲尔兹中尉赶赴现场，是第一位到达的急救人员。

sentences.en: He immediately recognised the Pontiac.
sentences.zh: 他一眼就认出了这辆庞蒂亚克。

sentences.en: With a population of just 5,000, Central City was small.
sentences.zh: 森特勒尔城人口只有5000人，是个小镇。

sentences.en: Degrees of separation between residents were few.
sentences.zh: 居民之间的距离很近，彼此都认识。

sentences.en: The vehicle hadn't been reported stolen, nor had anyone filed a missing persons report for its owner.
sentences.zh: 这辆车没有被报失，也没有人为其车主提交失踪人口报告。

sentences.en: Fields peered through the windows, but couldn't see anyone inside.
sentences.zh: 菲尔兹透过车窗向内张望，但看不到里面有任何人。

sentences.en: While examining the vehicle's exterior, Fields sighted what prompted the municipality employee to summon authorities.
sentences.zh: 在检查车辆外观时，菲尔兹看到了促使市政员工报警的东西。

sentences.en: Dripping from the locked trunk towards the ground were several streaks of what appeared to be blood.
sentences.zh: 从锁着的后备箱一直滴到地上的，是几道看起来像是血迹的痕迹。

sentences.en: A locksmith was summoned, who was able to unlock the trunk and lift the lid.
sentences.zh: 随后叫来了一名锁匠，他成功打开了后备箱并掀起了盖子。

sentences.en: Revealing the grisly scene within.
sentences.zh: 露出了里面毛骨悚然的场景。

sentences.en: Inside the Pontiac's trunk was the naked body of a woman, wrapped in a blanket and lying in the fetal position.
sentences.zh: 庞蒂亚克的后备箱里躺着一具女性裸尸，用毯子包裹着，呈胎儿状蜷缩着。

sentences.en: Her body was so badly battered and mutilated that she was unrecognisable.
sentences.zh: 她的尸体遭到严重殴打和残害，已经面目全非。

sentences.en: Blood caked her skin and hair in such excess, officers couldn't even determine her race.
sentences.zh: 鲜血大量凝固在她的皮肤和头发上，警员们甚至无法确定她的种族。

sentences.en: Eventually, police identified that the victim was the car's owner, 20-year-old Karina Mullen.
sentences.zh: 最终，警方确认死者是该车的车主、20岁的卡丽娜·穆伦。

sentences.en: Karina had been tortured before she died.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜在死前遭受了折磨。

sentences.en: She'd been stabbed twice, cut in the neck, and struck multiple times in the throat, either with a weapon or the culprit's fiSt.
sentences.zh: 她被刺了两刀，颈部被割伤，喉咙被钝器或凶手的拳头重击了多次。

sentences.en: There were so many abrasions that the medical examiner couldn't figure out where one injury ended and another began.
sentences.zh: 伤口实在太多，法医甚至分不清一处伤在哪里结束，另一处伤又从哪里开始。

sentences.en: There were bruises on her back and arms and one of her nipples had been sliced off.
sentences.zh: 她的背部和手臂上有淤青，其中一个乳头被割掉了。

sentences.en: Defensive wounds on her hands and wrists indicated that she'd put up a fight.
sentences.zh: 手部和手腕上的防御性伤口表明她进行过反抗。

sentences.en: Although the examiner didn't detect any semen, it was obvious Karina had endured severe trauma to her genitals.
sentences.zh: 尽管法医没有检测到任何精液，但很明显卡丽娜的生殖器受到了严重创伤。

sentences.en: A rape kit was taken.
sentences.zh: 提取了强奸检测样本。

sentences.en: Cause of death was asphyxiation.
sentences.zh: 死因是窒息。

sentences.en: Whoever had attacked Karina had repeatedly hit her in the head with a blunt instrument, which had broken her nose.
sentences.zh: 袭击卡丽娜的人用钝器多次击打她的头部，导致她的鼻子骨折。

sentences.en: This in turn blocked her airways and made it impossible for her to breathe.
sentences.zh: 这反过来阻塞了她的气道，使她无法呼吸。

sentences.en: Trace amounts of cannabis and a prescription painkiller were found in Karina's system, but she hadn't been impaired by either drugs or alcohol at the time of her death.
sentences.zh: 在卡丽娜体内发现了微量的大麻和一种处方止痛药，但在她死亡时，她并没有受到毒品或酒精的影响。

sentences.en: Central City was a town that saw its fair share of crime, primarily in the form of illicit drug dealings.
sentences.zh: 森特勒尔城也是一个罪案不少的城镇，主要以非法毒品交易为主。

sentences.en: But this was a murder of exceptional brutality and it sent shockwaves through the community.
sentences.zh: 但这起谋杀案极其残忍，在社区中引起了巨大震动。

sentences.en: The town's small size meant that most of the population had learned of Karina's murder within hours of her body being discovered.
sentences.zh: 小镇的规模很小，这意味着在发现尸体后的数小时内，大部分居民就都知道了卡丽娜被杀的消息。

sentences.en: Rumours and speculation as to who was responsible ran rife.
sentences.zh: 关于谁是凶手的谣言和猜测满天飞。

sentences.en: Tim Williams, a novelist who grew up in the area and was then a teenager who knew Karina,
sentences.zh: 蒂姆·威廉姆斯是一名小说家，他在该地区长大，当时是一名认识卡丽娜的青少年，

sentences.en: later wrote that he and his acquaintances began to fear a serial killer was on the loose in
sentences.zh: 他后来写道，他和相识的人开始担心有一个连环杀手在

sentences.en: Central City.
sentences.zh: 森特勒尔城游荡。

sentences.en: But others suspected Karina had been targeted by someone closer to home.
sentences.zh: 但其他人则怀疑卡丽娜是被身边熟悉的人盯上了。

sentences.en: The investigation into Karina Mullins' murder was jointly conducted by the Muhlenberg County
sentences.zh: 对卡丽娜·穆伦谋杀案的调查由穆伦堡县

sentences.en: Sheriff's Department, with Sheriff Harold McElvain at the helm, and the Central City Police
sentences.zh: 治安官部门（由治安官哈罗德·麦克尔万领导）和森特勒尔城警察

sentences.en: Department.
sentences.zh: 局联合进行。

sentences.en: Billy Fields led Central City's investigation.
sentences.zh: 比利·菲尔兹负责领导森特勒尔城的调查。

sentences.en: This was a personal case for Lieutenant Billy Fields.
sentences.zh: 对比利·菲尔兹中尉来说，这是一起私人的案件。

sentences.en: Like other members of the local law enforcement, he had come to know Karina when she performed clerical work at the station.
sentences.zh: 就像当地执法部门的其他成员一样，他是在卡丽娜在警局做文职工作时认识她的。

sentences.en: Karina had incurred a fine and the clerical duties were a form of community service.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜曾被罚款，文职工作是社区服务的一种形式。

sentences.en: Investigators worked to piece together Karina's last known movements.
sentences.zh: 调查人员努力拼凑卡丽娜最后的行踪。

sentences.en: Six weeks earlier, Karina had moved into an apartment on the northern end of Central City.
sentences.zh: 六周前，卡丽娜搬进了森特勒尔城北端的一间公寓。

sentences.en: But she'd suddenly decided that she wanted to resume living with her parents,
sentences.zh: 但她突然决定想重新和父母住在一起，

sentences.en: Claude and Patricia Mullin.
sentences.zh: 即克劳德和帕特里夏·穆伦。

sentences.en: At the time of her death, she was in the process of moving back home to the more rural area where they lived, ten miles outside of town.
sentences.zh: 在她死时，她正准备搬回父母居住的、位于城外十英里的更偏远地区。

sentences.en: Karina was a single mother to a two-year-old girl named Stephanie, who she completely adored.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜是一个两岁女孩斯蒂芬妮的单亲妈妈，她对女儿疼爱有加。

sentences.en: Karina's parents were supportive and helped her care for her daughter.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜的父母非常支持她，帮她照顾女儿。

sentences.en: Claude and Patricia told police that they'd last seen Karina the day before her body was found, when she'd dropped Stephanie off at their home so she could enjoy a night out
sentences.zh: 克劳德和帕特里夏告诉警察，他们最后一次见到卡丽娜是在发现她尸体的前一天，当时她把斯蒂芬妮送到他们家，以便她能和朋友

sentences.en: with friends.
sentences.zh: 出去玩一晚。

sentences.en: The plan was for her to return the next morning.
sentences.zh: 原计划是第二天早上回来。

sentences.en: Karina resided at the Hillwood Village Apartments with her roommate, 21-year-old Angela Smith.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜和21岁的室友安吉拉·史密斯住在希尔伍德村公寓。

sentences.en: Like Karina, Angela was a single mother with a toddler, and the two women, bonded over their shared experiences.
sentences.zh: 和卡丽娜一样，安吉拉也是一位带着幼儿的单亲妈妈，两个女人因为相似的经历而建立了深厚的感情。

sentences.en: Within a few short weeks, they became good friends.
sentences.zh: 在短短几周内，她们成为了好朋友。

sentences.en: Investigators made their way to Hillwood Village to search Karina's apartment.
sentences.zh: 调查人员前往希尔伍德村搜查卡丽娜的公寓。

sentences.en: The complex was spread out across six separate two-storey brick buildings, with green lawns and an outdoor parking lot in the middle.
sentences.zh: 该小区分布在六栋独立的双层砖混建筑中，中间有绿草地和一个室外停车场。

sentences.en: The apartment itself was tiny, with the two women's bedrooms divided by a thin wall.
sentences.zh: 公寓本身很小，两个女人的卧室被一堵薄墙隔开。

sentences.en: Karina's bedroom became a second crime scene.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜的卧室成了第二个犯罪现场。

sentences.en: Officers snapped photographs and took 23 items into evidence.
sentences.zh: 警员们拍摄了照片，并将23件物品作为物证带走。

sentences.en: Discarded on the floor by her bed were a pair of men's Lee brand jeans and a pair of men's underwear.
sentences.zh: 床边的地板上扔着一条男士李牌牛仔裤和一条男士内裤。

sentences.en: The bed itself was covered in blood, as was the floor.
sentences.zh: 床本身沾满了血迹，地板也是如此。

sentences.en: Angela Smith was stunned to learn what had happened to her roommate.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉·史密斯得知室友遭遇不测后震惊不已。

sentences.en: She last saw Karina on Thursday the 1St.
sentences.zh: 她最后一次见到卡丽娜是在10月1日，星期四。

sentences.en: With their children in the care of others, Angela and Karina decided to make the most of their night off from parenting and head to a bar in the city of Owensboro, 35 miles north
sentences.zh: 由于孩子们有人照顾，安吉拉和卡丽娜决定充分利用她们不用带娃的夜晚，前往位于森特勒尔城以北35英里的欧文斯伯勒市的一家酒吧。

sentences.en: of Central City.
sentences.zh: 森特勒尔城。

sentences.en: The pair took a Valium each and after a few drinks, returned home at around 11.30.
sentences.zh: 两人各吃了一片安定，喝了几杯后，于11点半左右回家。

sentences.en: They watched television together for a little while, then Angela went to bed.
sentences.zh: 她们一起看了一会儿电视，然后安吉拉上床睡觉了。

sentences.en: She'd slept soundly and hadn't heard any unusual noises during the night.
sentences.zh: 她睡得很香，夜里没有听到任何异常的声音。

sentences.en: But at some point, Karina was attacked, then either left or was taken from the apartment.
sentences.zh: 但在某个时刻，卡丽娜遭到袭击，随后被遗弃或带离了公寓。

sentences.en: Other residents of the Hillwood Village Apartments were interviewed.
sentences.zh: 希尔伍德村公寓的其他居民也受到了盘问。

sentences.en: None said they'd heard anything untoward on the night in question, even though the building's ceilings were thin and noise carried easily.
sentences.zh: 没有人说他们在事发当晚听到任何异常的声音，尽管大楼的天花板很薄，声音很容易传过去。

sentences.en: However, several Central City locals came forward claiming they'd seen Karina or her car on the night of the murder.
sentences.zh: 然而，几位森特勒尔城当地人站出来称，他们在谋杀当晚看到了卡丽娜或她的车。

sentences.en: One had spotted Karina sitting in her Pontiac outside of a restaurant on South 2nd Street at 11.30pm.
sentences.zh: 有人在晚上11点半看到卡丽娜坐在南二街一家餐厅外的庞蒂亚克汽车里。

sentences.en: Two women, Dana Morris and Tracey Vincent, had been parked in a shopping centre parking lot two hours later when they saw Karina's car drive by.
sentences.zh: 两名女性达娜·莫里斯和特雷西·文森特两小时后将车停在一个购物中心的停车场里，当时她们看到卡丽娜的车驶过。

sentences.en: But there was no sign of Karina.
sentences.zh: 但不见卡丽娜的踪影。

sentences.en: The only person inside the vehicle was a man behind the wheel.
sentences.zh: 车里唯一的另一个人是坐在驾驶座上的男子。

sentences.en: When investigators asked the women if they could identify the driver, they said that he looked a lot like a local nineteen-year-old named Jimmy Springer.
sentences.zh: 当调查人员询问这两位女性是否能认出司机时，她们说他看起来很像当地一个名叫吉米·斯普林格的19岁青年。

sentences.en: Karina Mullen had started dating Jimmy Springer six months earlier.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜·穆伦在六个月前开始与吉米·斯普林格约会。

sentences.en: Although a year younger than Karina, Springer was six foot two and well built, making him look older than his nineteen years.
sentences.zh: 虽然比卡丽娜小一岁，但斯普林格身高六尺二寸（约1米88）且身材魁梧，这让他看起来比19岁更成熟。

sentences.en: He worked odd jobs, primarily physical ones in construction or maintenance.
sentences.zh: 他做着零工，主要是建筑或维护方面的体力活。

sentences.en: Karina's family weren't thrilled about the relationship.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜的家人对这段恋情并不满意。

sentences.en: On multiple occasions, she had called her parents upset because the two had argued.
sentences.zh: 她曾多次因为两人争吵而打电话给父母诉苦。

sentences.en: Once, she went over to their house with her face scrubbed bright red.
sentences.zh: 有一次，她来到父母家，脸上被搓得通红。

sentences.en: Karina explained that during a fight, Springer had taken a washcloth and vigorously rubbed her face to remove the makeup she was wearing.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜解释说，在争吵过程中，斯普林格拿了一条毛巾用力擦洗她的脸，想洗掉她化好的妆。

sentences.en: Concerned, Claude Mullen told his daughter to end the relationship and move back home.
sentences.zh: 克劳德·穆伦听后很担心，告诉女儿结束这段恋情并搬回家里。

sentences.en: She agreed.
sentences.zh: 她同意了。

sentences.en: Karina's housemate Angela told police that when she'd gone to bed on the night of October 1,
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜的室友安吉拉告诉警方，当她在10月1日晚睡觉时，

sentences.en: Karina had asked her to leave the front door unlocked in case Springer came by later.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜曾让她把前门开着，以防斯普林格待会儿过来。

sentences.en: Angela agreed with Karina's parents that the relationship was a stormy one and that Springer was a jealous partner.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉和卡丽娜的父母一样，认为这段关系充满风波，而且斯普林格是一个好妒的伴侣。

sentences.en: Being Karina's boyfriend, Springer was an obvious suspect.
sentences.zh: 作为卡丽娜的男友，斯普林格显然是一个嫌疑人。

sentences.en: He told investigators that he'd also been out in Owensboro on the night of Thursday October 1, but he hadn't spent time with Karina.
sentences.zh: 他告诉调查人员，他也在10月1日星期四晚上去了欧文斯伯勒，但他没有和卡丽娜在一起。

sentences.en: Instead, he'd smoked cannabis, then drank at a bar with two friends, Jimmy Jones and Dale Duncan.
sentences.zh: 相反，他抽了大麻，然后和两个朋友吉米·琼斯和戴尔·邓肯在一家酒吧喝酒。

sentences.en: At around 11pm, they drove back to Dale's house before Springer decided to head over to Karina's apartment.
sentences.zh: 晚上11点左右，他们开车回戴尔家，之后斯普林格决定去卡丽娜的公寓。

sentences.en: He suspected that she was upset with him for going out with his friends and wanted to check in with her.
sentences.zh: 他怀疑她因为自己和朋友出去玩而生他的气，所以想去看看她。

sentences.en: Springer approached the apartment.
sentences.zh: 斯普林格走近公寓。

sentences.en: The front door was unlocked.
sentences.zh: 前门没锁。

sentences.en: He walked in and made his way to Karina's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 他走进去，径直走向卡丽娜的卧室。

sentences.en: The door was closed.
sentences.zh: 门是关着的。

sentences.en: Springer turned the handle, but it was locked.
sentences.zh: 斯普林格转动把手，但门锁上了。

sentences.en: He noticed two small smudges of what looked like blood on the door, but thought nothing of it.
sentences.zh: 他注意到门上有两个看起来像血迹的小污迹，但没把这放在心上。

sentences.en: Assuming Karina must be out, Springer got back in his car and drove around downtown Central City looking for her.
sentences.zh: 斯普林格以为卡丽娜肯定出去了，便重新上车，在森特勒尔城市中心到处转悠寻找她。

sentences.en: After searching unsuccessfully for between 15 and 20 minutes, he gave up.
sentences.zh: 在寻找15到20分钟无果后，他放弃了。

sentences.en: He went back to his friend Dale's house, where he stayed overnight.
sentences.zh: 他回到了朋友戴尔家，并在那里过夜。

sentences.en: Springer didn't go home until the next morning, when Karina's body was found.
sentences.zh: 直到第二天早上发现卡丽娜的尸体时，斯普林格才回家。

sentences.en: Investigators weren't buying his story.
sentences.zh: 调查人员并不买账他的说辞。

sentences.en: Springer's tale about finding Karina's bedroom door locked and smeared with blood seemed especially suspicious.
sentences.zh: 斯普林格关于发现卡丽娜卧室门锁着且涂有血迹的说法显得尤其可疑。

sentences.en: Why hadn't he called the police or been more concerned?
sentences.zh: 他为什么没有报警或者表现得更关心一点？

sentences.en: They theorised that something caused him to become jealous that night.
sentences.zh: 他们推测，当晚有什么事让他心生嫉妒。

sentences.en: Then, fuelled by drugs and alcohol, he killed Karina in a violent rage.
sentences.zh: 然后，在毒品和酒精的驱使下，他在暴怒中杀死了卡丽娜。

sentences.en: When the Mullins learned that Karina's boyfriend was a suspect, they pleaded with Springer and his family not to attend her funeral.
sentences.zh: 当穆伦一家得知卡丽娜的男友是嫌疑人时，他们恳求斯普林格及其家人不要参加她的葬礼。

sentences.en: When Karina was laid to rest three days after her body was recovered, they stayed away.
sentences.zh: 在卡丽娜尸体被找到三天后入土为安时，他们没有出席。

sentences.en: Almost two weeks after their first conversation with Springer, investigators asked to speak with him again.
sentences.zh: 在与斯普林格进行首次对话将近两周后，调查人员要求再次与他交谈。

sentences.en: They hadn't recorded his initial interview or taken any notes, so this time they aimed to obtain a signed statement.
sentences.zh: 他们没有录下他最初的谈话，也没有做任何记录，所以这一次他们的目标是获得一份签字的供述。

sentences.en: While providing his version of events, Springer made a number of remarks that officers deemed suspicious.
sentences.zh: 在讲述自己的事件经过时，斯普林格说了许多警员认为可疑的话。

sentences.en: Their focus on him intensified.
sentences.zh: 他们对他的关注更加集中了。

sentences.en: In late October that year, Jimmy Springer was put behind bars.
sentences.zh: 当年10月下旬，吉米·斯普林格被关进大牢。

sentences.en: He was held on charges of grand larceny, accused of stealing a $3,000 computer monitor from his workplace.
sentences.zh: 他因涉嫌重大盗窃罪被拘留，被控从工作场所盗窃了一台价值3000美元的电脑显示器。

sentences.en: When security guards questioned Springer following the theft, he referenced the murder of Karina Mullen in a highly suspicious manner.
sentences.zh: 当保安在盗窃发生后盘问斯普林格时，他以一种高度可疑的方式提到了卡丽娜·穆伦的谋杀案。

sentences.en: The guards then passed this intel onto the police.
sentences.zh: 保安随后将此情报转达给了警方。

sentences.en: While sitting in his jail cell in late November, eight weeks after Karina was found in the trunk of her car,
sentences.zh: 11月下旬，正当卡丽娜在车后备箱被发现八周后，斯普林格坐在牢房里时，

sentences.en: Springer was indicted for her murder.
sentences.zh: 他因谋杀罪被起诉。

sentences.en: Springer pleaded guilty to grand larceny and served a sentence in Nashville.
sentences.zh: 斯普林格对重大盗窃罪表示认罪，并在纳什维尔服刑。

sentences.en: Then authorities handed him over to Muhlenberg County in March 1988.
sentences.zh: 随后，当局于1988年3月将他移交给穆伦堡县。

sentences.en: Karina's family were relieved that her killer was behind bars and would have to answer for his crimes.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜的家人感到欣慰，因为凶手已经锒铛入狱，并将为他的罪行负责。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, investigators were steadily building their case.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，调查人员一直在稳步收集证据。

sentences.en: Some forensic evidence existed in the form of blood and hair samples taken from Karina's body,
sentences.zh: 存在一些法医证据，即从卡丽娜尸体上提取的血液和毛发样本，

sentences.en: but these were assumed to have come from Karina and were never compared to Jimmy Springer.
sentences.zh: 但人们认为这些样本来自卡丽娜，从未与吉米·斯普林格进行比对。

sentences.en: Although a rape kit had been collected, it was never tested.
sentences.zh: 尽管收集了强奸检测样本，但从未对其进行检测。

sentences.en: And there wasn't much available in terms of eyewitness reports.
sentences.zh: 在目击者报告方面也没有太多可用信息。

sentences.en: No one had seen any blood on Springer around the time of Karina's murder, nor had they seen him with her body.
sentences.zh: 在卡丽娜遇害前后，没有人看到斯普林格身上有血迹，也没有人看到他带着她的尸体。

sentences.en: Detectives primarily focused on circumstantial evidence.
sentences.zh: 侦探们主要集中在间接证据上。

sentences.en: Springer had a history of drug abuse and criminal behaviour.
sentences.zh: 斯普林格有吸毒和犯罪行为的历史。

sentences.en: As Karina's boyfriend, he was the most likely suspect.
sentences.zh: 作为卡丽娜的男友，他是嫌疑最大的人。

sentences.en: Two people were almost certain they'd seen him driving her car at 1.30am on the night in question.
sentences.zh: 有两个人几乎可以肯定，在事发当晚凌晨1点30分，他们看到他开着她的车。

sentences.en: And his story about leaving her apartment after finding her bedroom door locked, smeared with blood, sounded too absurd to be true.
sentences.zh: 而他关于在发现卡丽娜卧室门锁着、上面沾有血迹后离开公寓的说法，听起来太荒谬了，不可能是真的。

sentences.en: Jimmy Springer's trial began in July 1988.
sentences.zh: 吉米·斯普林格的审判于1988年7月开始。

sentences.en: He pleaded not guilty.
sentences.zh: 他做出了无罪抗辩。

sentences.en: The prosecution called multiple law enforcement officers to testify, as well as witnesses Dana Morris and Tracey Vincent,
sentences.zh: 控方传唤了多名执法人员出庭作证，以及证人达娜·莫里斯和特雷西·文森特，

sentences.en: who were sure they'd seen Springer behind the wheel of Karina's car.
sentences.zh: 他们确信自己曾看到斯普林格坐在卡琳娜的车里。

sentences.en: Springer took the stand in his own defence, telling the court that he'd been extremely disturbed by Karina's murder and was in no way responsible.
sentences.zh: 斯普林格出庭为自己辩护，他告诉法庭，他对卡琳娜的谋杀感到极为不安，并且绝对没有责任。

sentences.en: He'd maintained his innocence from the beginning, even though he'd felt pressured to confess during his second interview with police.
sentences.zh: 他从一开始就坚称自己是无辜的，尽管他在接受警方第二次讯问时感到了逼供的压力。

sentences.en: The interviewing officers had reassured him that they understood why he'd killed Karina.
sentences.zh: 负责审讯的警官曾向他保证，他们理解他为什么要杀卡琳娜。

sentences.en: That he'd done it out of love.
sentences.zh: 说他是出于爱才这么做的。

sentences.en: Springer vehemently denied making certain incriminating remarks which police had attributed to him.
sentences.zh: 斯普林格坚决否认自己说过警方归咎于他的某些涉案言论。

sentences.en: When the prosecutor responded by asking if he was alleging a police officer had made a false statement,
sentences.zh: 当检察官反问他是否是在指控警官作虚假陈述时，

sentences.en: Springer retorted, I believe he's not the first person that said something false in this case.
sentences.zh: 斯普林格反驳道：“我认为他并不是本案中第一个说谎的人。”

sentences.en: Jimmy Springer's friends Dale Duncan and Jimmy Jones also testified, backing up the alibi that he provided for the night of October 1, 1987.
sentences.zh: 吉米·斯普林格的朋友戴尔·邓肯和吉米·琼斯也出庭作证，支持他为1987年10月1日晚提供的不在场证明。

sentences.en: He was with them for the entire night except for a period of 15 to 20 minutes when he went looking for Karina.
sentences.zh: 他整晚都和他们在一起，除了有15到20分钟的时间他出去寻找卡琳娜。

sentences.en: Dale said Springer returned straight back to his home and stayed overnight.
sentences.zh: 戴尔说斯普林格直接回了家并在那里过夜。

sentences.en: The trial lasted just three days.
sentences.zh: 审判仅持续了三天。

sentences.en: During his closing address, the prosecutor instructed the jury to ignore how clean cut Springer looked as he sat in court.
sentences.zh: 在结案陈词中，检察官指示陪审团不要理会斯普林格坐在法庭上时那副清爽干净的模样。

sentences.en: Instead, he asked them to picture Springer as the violent, drug-fuelled individual that he would have been on the night of the murder.
sentences.zh: 相反，他要求他们把斯普林格想象成案发当晚那种充满暴力、吸食了毒品的个人。

sentences.en: In contrast, Springer's attorney argued that the prosecution did not meet their burden of proving
sentences.zh: 相比之下，斯普林格的律师辩称，控方没有履行举证责任，

sentences.en: Springer was guilty beyond a reasonable doubt, stating,
sentences.zh: 证明斯普林格有罪且无可置疑，他说道：

sentences.en: I say to you again that Jim Springer is not guilty of murdering Karina Mullen.
sentences.zh: “我再次向你们重申，吉米·斯普林格没有谋杀卡琳娜·穆伦。”

sentences.en: It took one hour for the jury to reach a verdict.
sentences.zh: 陪审团花了一个小时就达成了裁决。

sentences.en: Jimmy Springer was found not guilty.
sentences.zh: 吉米·斯普林格被判无罪。

sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回。谢谢支持本期节目的赞助商。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《案件档案》继续为您提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Case File to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜的家人悲痛欲绝。

sentences.en: Karina's family was devastated.
sentences.zh: 审判结束后，穆伦堡县当局宣布该案实际上已经结案。

sentences.en: Following the trial, Mullenberg County authorities declared the case effectively closed.
sentences.zh: 除非出现牵连其他人的证据，否则他们将不会继续调查。

sentences.en: Unless evidence emerged implicating another person in the crime, they would not be investigating it.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，负有责任的人已经接受了审判并逃脱了法网。

sentences.en: As far as they were concerned, the person responsible had been tried and got away with it.
sentences.zh: 1988年12月，警方将卡琳娜那辆1977年产的庞蒂亚克轿车交还给了她的父母。

sentences.en: In December 1988, police returned Karina's 1977 Pontiac to her parents.
sentences.zh: 拿到车后，克劳德和帕特里夏·穆伦决定往车里看一看。

sentences.en: Upon receiving the car, Claude and Patricia Mullen decided to look inside.
sentences.zh: 车里散落着许多无害的物品。

sentences.en: A number of innocuous items were scattered around the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 然后，他们检查了驾驶座下方。

sentences.en: Then, they checked under the driver's seat.
sentences.zh: 卡在座椅下方的是一把沾满干血迹和人类毛发的刀。

sentences.en: Wedged beneath the seat was a knife, caked in dried blood and human hairs.
sentences.zh: 发现用来杀害他们女儿的凶器不仅令人创伤深重，

sentences.en: Discovering the weapon used against their daughter was not only traumatising,
sentences.zh: 也坚定了克劳德和帕特里夏日益强烈的信念：侦探们把她谋杀案的调查搞砸了。

sentences.en: it affirmed Claude and Patricia's growing belief that detectives had botched the investigation into her murder.
sentences.zh: 中央市警察局长为这一疏忽辩解道：

sentences.en: The Central City Police Chief defended the oversight, noting,
sentences.zh: “这把刀确实有可能被忽略了。”

sentences.en: It's possible that the knife could have been overlooked.
sentences.zh: “由于它卡在座椅深处，我们确实有可能漏掉这一点。”

sentences.en: With it being lodged down in the seat, it's possible that we could have missed that.
sentences.zh: 这把刀被送到州当局进行检测。

sentences.en: The knife was sent to state authorities for testing.
sentences.zh: 由于对中央市警察局办案能力完全持怀疑态度，穆伦夫妇要求将案件移交给肯塔基州警察局。

sentences.en: Entirely dubious of the Central City Police Department's ability to do their job, the Mullins requested that the case also be transferred to Kentucky State Police.
sentences.zh: 他们的请求得到了批准。

sentences.en: Their request was granted.
sentences.zh: 血迹斑斑的刀的发现以及案件的移交，都没有带来穆伦夫妇所期盼的突破。

sentences.en: Neither the discovery of the blood-stained knife nor the transfer of the case led to the breakthrough that the Mullins were hoping for.
sentences.zh: 到了1989年初，他们仍在等待实验室的结果。

sentences.en: By the beginning of 1989, they were still awaiting lab results.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们发现这把刀没有查出任何重大线索。

sentences.en: Eventually, they found out that nothing significant was uncovered from the knife.
sentences.zh: 他们继续请愿要求破获卡琳娜的案件，同时还要抚养她如今已经四岁的女儿斯蒂芬妮。

sentences.en: They continued to petition for Karina's case to be solved, while also raising her now four-year-old daughter, Stephanie.
sentences.zh: 克劳德·穆伦对肯塔基州报纸《信使问询报》说：

sentences.en: Claude Mullen told Kentucky newspaper, The Messenger Enquirer,
sentences.zh: “这太难了。”

sentences.en: It's so hard.
sentences.zh: “老实说，我们过得并不好。”

sentences.en: Truthfully, we're not doing too good.
sentences.zh: “我们只是在勉强过好每一天。”

sentences.en: We're just trying to make it day to day.
sentences.zh: 帕特里夏·穆伦谈到了全家人持续的悲痛，她说道：

sentences.en: Patricia Mullins spoke of the family's ongoing grief, stating,
sentences.zh: “至于对她的思念，我无法用言语表达我们有多想念她。”

sentences.en: As far as missing her, I can't put it into words how much we do.
sentences.zh: “我只是找不到任何答案。”

sentences.en: I just don't have any answers.
sentences.zh: “我不明白一个人怎么会那样死去，却依然没有人为之承担责任。”

sentences.en: I don't understand how someone can die like that, and still no one has been held responsible for it.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，吉米·斯普林格已经继续他的生活了。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Jimmy Springer had moved on with his life.
sentences.zh: 他留在了中央市，但没有人真正因为这起谋杀案去纠缠他。

sentences.en: He stayed in Central City, but no one really bothered him about the murder.
sentences.zh: 偶尔，他会在镇上看到该案的首席调查员比利·菲尔兹中尉，这位警官会向他挥手致意。

sentences.en: Occasionally, he saw the case's lead investigator, Lieutenant Billy Fields, around town, and the officer would wave at him.
sentences.zh: 斯普林格只是不理睬他。

sentences.en: Springer just ignored him.
sentences.zh: 他开始在当地一家快递公司工作并结了婚。

sentences.en: He began working for a local courier service and got married.
sentences.zh: 在接受《信使问询报》采访时，斯普林格表示：

sentences.en: In an interview with The Messenger Enquirer, Springer stated,
sentences.zh: “这很难，是的，但我必须继续生活。”

sentences.en: It's hard, yes, but I have to go on.
sentences.zh: “我仍然会做噩梦。”

sentences.en: I still have nightmares.
sentences.zh: “我仍然会想起她死去的方式，但我试着把它抛在脑后。”

sentences.en: I still think of the way she died, but I try to push it out of my mind.
sentences.zh: “我问自己为什么会这么残忍。”

sentences.en: I ask myself why it was so brutal.
sentences.zh: “我不愿去想她经历了什么。”

sentences.en: I hate to think about what she went through.
sentences.zh: “尽管这对我们很糟糕，但我们知道对她的父母来说更糟。”

sentences.en: As bad as it is for us, we know it's worse for her parents.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜遇害两周年转瞬即逝。

sentences.en: The second anniversary of Karina's death came and went.
sentences.zh: 接着，在1990年1月，穆伦堡县举行了警长选举。

sentences.en: Then, in January 1990, an election was held in Muhlenberg County for the position of Sheriff.
sentences.zh: 在任者是哈罗德·麦尔凡，他曾协助领导对卡琳娜谋杀案的调查。

sentences.en: The incumbent was Harold McElvain, who had helped lead the investigation into Karina's murder.
sentences.zh: 与他竞选的是韦恩·摩尔，他的竞选纲领是如果当选，将重新调查这起臭名昭著的未解悬案。

sentences.en: Running against him was Wayne Moore, who ran on the platform that he would reopen the notorious unsolved case if he won.
sentences.zh: 摩尔公开批评两个机构协调调查的方式，称：

sentences.en: More was publicly critical of the way both agencies had coordinated their investigation, saying,
sentences.zh: “如果一开始就妥善处理，这件事早就结案了，现在也早就定罪了。”

sentences.en: If it had been handled properly in the first place, this thing would have been closed and there would have been a conviction by now.
sentences.zh: 韦恩·摩尔击败了麦尔凡警长。

sentences.en: Wayne Moore defeated Sheriff McElvain.
sentences.zh: 他信守承诺，重新调查了卡琳娜·穆伦案，并指派他的副手特里·阿内特领导调查。

sentences.en: True to his word, he reopened the Karina Mullen case and appointed one of his deputies, Terry Arnett, to lead the investigation.
sentences.zh: 摩尔和阿内特联系了中央市警察局，要求查阅他们的证据。

sentences.en: Moore and Arnett reached out to the Central City Police Department to request access to their evidence.
sentences.zh: 他们承认，过去两年里，与该案有关的所有资料不知怎么都丢失了。

sentences.en: They admitted that everything they had relating to the case had somehow been lost during the past two years.
sentences.zh: 沮丧的摩尔向公众公开呼吁任何知晓卡琳娜谋杀案信息的人站出来。

sentences.en: Frustrated, Moore issued public appeals for anyone with information about Karina's murder to come forward.
sentences.zh: 一天，穆伦堡县警长办公室的电话响了。

sentences.en: One day, the phone rang at the Muhlenberg County Sheriff's Office.
sentences.zh: 摩尔接了电话。

sentences.en: Moore answered.
sentences.zh: 一个未知的男 caller 质问他为什么要插手卡琳娜·穆伦案。

sentences.en: An unidentified male caller demanded to know why he was meddling in the Karina Mullen case.
sentences.zh: 摩尔解释说他想让此案水落石出。

sentences.en: Moore explained that he wanted it solved.
sentences.zh: 匿名来电者威胁道。

sentences.en: The anonymous caller threatened.
sentences.zh: “听我一句劝，少管闲事，否则你会发现你的屁股掉进绿河里，”他指的是从镇旁流过的一条支流。

sentences.en: Take my advice and stay out of it or you'll find your arse in the Green River, referring to a tributary that passed right by town.
sentences.zh: 摩尔反驳道。

sentences.en: Moore retorted.
sentences.zh: “我会游泳。”

sentences.en: I can swim.
sentences.zh: 然后挂断了电话。

sentences.en: Then hung up the phone.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几天里，摩尔接到了更多的电话。

sentences.en: Over the next few days, Moore calls followed.
sentences.zh: 其中一次，来电者警告摩尔：

sentences.en: During one, the caller warned Moore to,
sentences.zh: “少管闲事，否则有人就要把你的屁股撕碎了。”

sentences.en: Leave things alone or somebody is fixing to tear your arse up.
sentences.zh: 在另一次电话中，一个威胁的声音让他想想自己有多在乎妻子和孩子。

sentences.en: In another, a menacing voice asked him to consider how much he cared about his wife and children.
sentences.zh: 摩尔没有被吓退。

sentences.en: Moore was undeterred.
sentences.zh: 虽然采取了保护家人的预防措施，但他决心要让案件真相大白。

sentences.en: Precautions were put in place to protect his family, but he remained determined to see the case solved.
sentences.zh: 他确信这些威胁电话意味着凶手或凶手们被他的深挖给镇住了。

sentences.en: He was convinced that the threatening calls meant the killer, or killers, were rattled by his digging.
sentences.zh: 摩尔通过《信使问询报》发表了一份公开声明，称：

sentences.en: Moore issued a public statement via the Messenger Inquirer, stating,
sentences.zh: “刀山火海也无法阻止我。”

sentences.en: Hell or high water won't stop me.
sentences.zh: “人们开始冒汗了。”

sentences.en: People are starting to sweat.
sentences.zh: “我想有些人真的很害怕。”

sentences.en: I think some people are really getting scared.
sentences.zh: “我们有一些不错的线索，但目前它们也只是线索。”

sentences.en: We've got some good leads, but that's all they are right now.
sentences.zh: “这些都是间接证据。”

sentences.en: It's circumstantial stuff.
sentences.zh: “但我们陷得太深，现在已经无法退缩了。”

sentences.en: But we're in too deep to back out now.
sentences.zh: 由于需要进一步协助，摩尔于1992年向联邦调查局寻求帮助。

sentences.en: Requiring further assistance, Moore requested help from the Federal Bureau of Investigation in 1992.
sentences.zh: 他们尖端的技术远远优于穆伦堡县警长办公室拥有的任何设备。

sentences.en: Their cutting-edge technology was far superior to anything possessed by the Muhlenberg County Sheriff's Department.
sentences.zh: 借助精密的激光，联邦调查局特工花了十个小时一丝不苟地检查了卡琳娜的车。

sentences.en: Using sophisticated lasers, FBI agents spent ten hours meticulously examining Karina's car.
sentences.zh: 他们能够识别出后备箱外侧一些之前调查人员未曾察觉的血手印。

sentences.en: They were able to identify some bloody prints on the boot's exterior that had gone undetected by earlier investigators.
sentences.zh: 摩尔兴奋不已。

sentences.en: Moore was excited.
sentences.zh: 如果他能找到匹配的指纹——无论是在数据库中已有的还是以后某时找到的——他就能顺理成章地实施逮捕了。

sentences.en: If he was able to find a matching print, either already in the database or sometime down the track, he'd be well on his way to making an arreSt.
sentences.zh: 摩尔和副手阿内特将这个好消息分享给了穆伦夫妇，同时提醒他们前路依然漫长。

sentences.en: Moore and Deputy Arnett shared the good news with the Mullins, while cautioning them that they still had a long way to go.
sentences.zh: 但克劳德欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: But Claude was thrilled.
sentences.zh: 四年来，他第一次有了值得积极看待的事情。

sentences.en: For the first time in four years, he finally had something to feel positive about.
sentences.zh: 随着调查再次放缓，穆伦夫妇的希望破灭了。

sentences.en: The Mullins' hope dissipated when the investigation slowed again.
sentences.zh: 从表面上看，似乎什么都没有发生。

sentences.en: From the outside, it appeared as though nothing was happening.
sentences.zh: 几个月，然后几年过去了，直到距离卡琳娜遇害已经过去了二十个年头。

sentences.en: Months, then years passed, until two decades had gone by since Karina's murder.
sentences.zh: 在这段漫长的时间里，一个女人一直保守着一个能让此案取得重大突破的秘密。

sentences.en: For that entire time, a woman was holding onto a secret that could break the case wide open.
sentences.zh: 她所需要做的就是开口说出来。

sentences.en: All she needed to do was speak up.
sentences.zh: 16岁的莎拉（化名）独自走在中央市通往她家的街道上。

sentences.en: Sixteen-year-old Sarah, not her real name, walked alone down the central city streets leading towards her home.
sentences.zh: 那是1987年10月1日星期四的夜晚，莎拉在朋友家度过了整个傍晚。

sentences.en: It was night time on Thursday, October 1, 1987, and Sarah had spent the evening at a friend's house.
sentences.zh: 中央市有其阴暗的地下世界和持续不断的涉毒犯罪，但它仍然是一个小镇，青少年在天黑后独自在外感到很安全。

sentences.en: Central city had its murky underworld and ongoing drug-related crimes, but it was still a small town where teenagers felt safe being out alone after dark.
sentences.zh: 莎拉刚走到家人的房子附近，一辆警车就停了下来。

sentences.en: Sarah just reached her family's home when a police cruiser pulled up.
sentences.zh: 两名男子从车里下来，径直朝她走去。

sentences.en: Two men got out of the vehicle and walked straight up to her.
sentences.zh: 他们突然抓住她，把她拖进了汽车后座。

sentences.en: They suddenly grabbed her and dragged her into the back seat of the car.
sentences.zh: 莎拉吓坏了。

sentences.en: Sarah was terrified.
sentences.zh: 其中一名男子体型庞大。

sentences.en: One of the men was huge.
sentences.zh: 他看起来二十出头，身高六英尺五英寸（约1.96米），身材魁梧，脸庞圆而胖乎乎的。

sentences.en: He looked to be in his early twenties and was six foot five inches tall with a heavyset build and a round pudgy face.
sentences.zh: 莎拉从未见过他。

sentences.en: Sarah had never seen him before.
sentences.zh: 但她认出了她的另一名绑架者。

sentences.en: But she recognised her other abductor.
sentences.zh: 他在镇上非常有名，是一个身材魁梧的男子，身高六英尺三（约1.91米），体重265磅（约120公斤）。

sentences.en: Very well known around town, he was an imposing man, standing six foot three and weighing 265 pounds.
sentences.zh: 他就是44岁的中央市警察局中尉比利·菲尔兹。

sentences.en: It was 44-year-old Central City Police Lieutenant, Billy Fields.
sentences.zh: 这两名男子开车带着莎拉行驶了一段短距离，然后把车停下。

sentences.en: The two men drove Sarah a short distance, then parked the car.
sentences.zh: 当她被强行带下车时，她发现他们来到了山林村公寓小区。

sentences.en: As she was forced outside, she saw they were at the Hillwood Village Apartments Complex.
sentences.zh: 她被押送进其中一间住宅。

sentences.en: She was marched up to one of the residences.
sentences.zh: 那是卡琳娜·穆伦和她的室友安吉拉·史密斯合租的公寓，两人当时都在家。

sentences.en: It was the apartment Carina Mullen shared with her flatmate, Angela Smith, both of whom were home.
sentences.zh: 现场还有其他几名男子，包括卡琳娜的男友吉米·斯普林格，

sentences.en: Several other men were also present, including Carina's boyfriend to Jimmy Springer,
sentences.zh: 一个莎拉认识的个子矮小的18岁男孩吉米·斯普林格，以及另一个她不认识的人。

sentences.en: a short 18-year-old Sarah knew named Jimmy Springer, and another individual whom she didn't know.
sentences.zh: 这群人似乎只是在夜出归来后坐在一起喝酒。

sentences.en: The group seemed to be just sitting around and drinking after a night out.
sentences.zh: 突然间，菲尔兹开始找卡琳娜的麻烦。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, Fields began picking a fight with Carina.
sentences.zh: 莎拉听不懂发生了什么，但听起来他们是在为卡琳娜怀孕的事争吵。

sentences.en: Sarah couldn't understand what was going on, but it sounded as though they were arguing about Carina being pregnant.
sentences.zh: 菲尔兹突然抓住卡琳娜，把她拉进她的卧室。

sentences.en: Fields suddenly grabbed Carina and pulled her into her bedroom.
sentences.zh: 那个曾帮忙绑架莎拉的高大男子站起身，把莎拉推进了他们身后的房间里。

sentences.en: The large man who had helped abduct Sarah got up and pushed Sarah into the room behind them.
sentences.zh: 吉米·斯普林格和吉米·克拉默也跟了进去。

sentences.en: They were also followed by Jimmy Springer and Jimmy Kramer.
sentences.zh: 莎拉听到菲尔兹冲着卡琳娜咆哮，说她会得到她应得的下场。

sentences.en: Sarah heard Fields snarl at Carina that she was going to get what she deserved.
sentences.zh: 他用一根金属棒残忍地殴打卡琳娜，然后把她扔到床上，当着所有人的面强奸了她。

sentences.en: He viciously beat Carina with a metal bar, before throwing her on the bed and raping her in front of everyone.
sentences.zh: 他一边反复击打她，一边告诉她闭嘴。

sentences.en: He punched her repeatedly while telling her to keep her mouth shut.
sentences.zh: 克拉默和另一名绑架者也加入殴打和威胁的行列，随后同样强奸了卡琳娜。

sentences.en: Kramer and the other abductor joined in on the beating and threats, then also raped Carina.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜的男友吉米·斯普林格似乎并非自愿参与。

sentences.en: Carina's boyfriend, Jimmy Springer, didn't seem to be a willing participant.
sentences.zh: 他从未打过卡琳娜，有时还试图帮助她，但被其他男子制止了。

sentences.en: He never hit Carina and at times tried to help her, but was stopped by the other men.
sentences.zh: 这三人最终坚持要求斯普林格也强奸卡琳娜。

sentences.en: The three of them eventually insisted that Springer rape Carina as well.
sentences.zh: 在整场残酷的袭击中，卡琳娜的室友安吉拉在隔壁房间歇斯底里地啜泣，但没有进行干预。

sentences.en: Throughout the vicious attack, Carina's housemate Angela sobbed hysterically from the next room, but didn't intervene.
sentences.zh: 莎拉惊恐地看着这一切。

sentences.en: Sarah watched on in terror.
sentences.zh: 她无法帮助卡琳娜，因为她被其中一名男子死死按住。

sentences.en: She couldn't help Carina because she was being forcefully held down by one of the men.
sentences.zh: 菲尔兹最终将注意力转向莎拉，把她推到卡琳娜身上的床上对她进行性侵犯。

sentences.en: Fields eventually turned his attention to Sarah, pushing her on the bed on top of Carina and sexually assaulting her.
sentences.zh: 然后菲尔兹再次强奸了卡琳娜，同时用刀对她进行刺划。

sentences.en: Then Fields raped Carina again while using a knife to stab and cut her.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜最初尖叫并试图反抗，但菲尔兹掐住她的脖子，直到她再也发不出声音。

sentences.en: Carina had initially screamed and tried to fight back, but Fields choked her until she could no longer make a sound.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜最初尖叫并试图反抗，但菲尔兹掐住她的脖子，直到她再也发不出声音。

sentences.en: Naked and soaked in blood, Carina was unrecognisable.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜全身赤裸、浑身是血，面目全非。

sentences.en: Sarah couldn't tell if she was dead or just unconscious.
sentences.zh: 萨拉分不清她究竟是已经死了，还是只是失去了知觉。

sentences.en: Fields and his main accomplice picked up Carina's body and placed her in the boot of her own car.
sentences.zh: 菲尔兹和他的主要同伙抬起卡丽娜的尸体，将她放进她自己汽车的后备箱里。

sentences.en: Fields then climbed into the passenger seat and ordered Sarah to drive the Pontiac to a garage used by a municipal department downtown.
sentences.zh: 随后，菲尔兹坐进副驾驶座，命令萨拉开着庞蒂亚克汽车前往市中心一个市政部门使用的车库。

sentences.en: Sarah did as she was told.
sentences.zh: 萨拉照着他的吩咐做了。

sentences.en: Fields provided directions as she drove, interspersed with threats as to what would happen to her if she ever told anyone what she'd seen.
sentences.zh: 在她开车时，菲尔兹一直在给她指路，其中夹杂着威胁，警告她如果敢把看到的任何人说出去会有什么下场。

sentences.en: Dawn was breaking as Sarah pulled up at the garage on Legion Drive.
sentences.zh: 当萨拉把车开到勒容大道的车库时，天刚好亮了。

sentences.en: The other man who had abducted her earlier in the night headed to the garage in his own car and was already there, waiting for them.
sentences.zh: 当天夜里早些时候绑架萨拉的另一名男子开着自己的车前往车库，已经在那里等着他们了。

sentences.en: Sarah put the Pontiac into park and got out.
sentences.zh: 萨拉将庞蒂亚克汽车挂入停车档并下了车。

sentences.en: While the two men headed to the boot where Carina's body lay, Sarah spotted her opportunity to escape.
sentences.zh: 正当两名男子走向放着卡丽娜尸体的后备箱时，萨拉发现了逃跑的机会。

sentences.en: She raced as quickly as she could in the direction of her home.
sentences.zh: 她以最快的速度朝家的方向奔跑。

sentences.en: The following morning, a call came through to Central City Police regarding the discovery of Carina Mullen's car.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，中央城警察局接到一个报警电话，称发现了卡丽娜·穆伦的汽车。

sentences.en: Billy Fields responded to the call and was the first to arrive at the scene.
sentences.zh: 比利·菲尔兹接警出动，是第一个到达现场的人。

sentences.en: He was later placed in charge of the investigation into Carina's murder.
sentences.zh: 他后来被指派负责调查卡丽娜的谋杀案。

sentences.en: Sarah confided in her mother but didn't tell anyone else what had happened.
sentences.zh: 萨拉向母亲吐露了实情，但没有把发生的事告诉其他人。

sentences.en: They stayed silent about the matter from then on, terrified of the repercussions if they spoke out against the well-known local police officer.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，他们对这件事三缄其口，因为害怕如果公开指控这位当地颇有名气的警官会遭到报复。

sentences.en: Even when Sarah's sister later started dating Jimmy Kramer and her father began working alongside him, Sarah kept her secret.
sentences.zh: 甚至在后来萨拉的姐姐开始与吉米·克拉默交往、她的父亲开始与吉米共事时，萨拉也保守着这个秘密。

sentences.en: In the years that followed, Sarah worked with Kentucky State Police as an informant in several drugs cases.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几年里，萨拉曾作为肯塔基州警察局的线人，协助破获了多起毒品案件。

sentences.en: Billy Fields called Sarah from time to time, muttering threats down the phone and warning her against speaking out.
sentences.zh: 比利·菲尔兹不时给萨拉打电话，在电话里嘟囔着威胁她，警告她不要把事情说出去。

sentences.en: She never said a word to anyone until mid-2006.
sentences.zh: 直到2006年中期以前，她从未向任何人吐露过半个字。

sentences.en: Sarah, who was now 35 years old, was talking with Kentucky State Police Detective Steve Silfies about an unrelated crime.
sentences.zh: 当时已经35岁的萨拉正与肯塔基州警察局侦探史蒂夫·西尔菲斯谈论一桩不相关的犯罪案件。

sentences.en: It was during this conversation when she finally confessed that she had witnessed the murder of Carina Mullen.
sentences.zh: 正是在这次谈话中，她终于承认自己目睹了卡丽娜·穆伦被谋杀的过程。

sentences.en: Silfies gave her details to a colleague named Detective Damon Fleming, who'd recently been assigned the almost 20-year-old cold case.
sentences.zh: 西尔菲斯将她的情况转告给了一位名叫达蒙·弗莱明侦探的同事，后者最近刚接手这起尘封了近20年的悬案。

sentences.en: Fleming inherited a wealth of information regarding Carina's murder from Muhlenberg County Sheriff's Deputy Terry Arnett, who'd doggedly pursued the case for years.
sentences.zh: 弗莱明从穆伦堡县警长办公室副警长特里·阿内特那里继承了大量关于卡丽娜谋杀案的信息，后者多年来一直锲而不舍地追查此案。

sentences.en: Arnett had been getting close to the truth and was certain he knew who the killers were.
sentences.zh: 阿内特当时已经接近真相，并且坚信自己知道凶手是谁。

sentences.en: He felt so confident that they would one day have enough to make an arrest that he reassured Claude Mullen on multiple occasions, don't give up, we know who did it.
sentences.zh: 他坚信他们总有一天能掌握足够证据实施逮捕，因此他曾多次安慰克劳德·穆伦：不要放弃，我们知道是谁干的。

sentences.en: Then, in 2004, Arnett was diagnosed with cancer.
sentences.zh: 然而在2004年，阿内特被诊断出患有癌症。

sentences.en: He died the following year without having solved Carina's murder.
sentences.zh: 他在次年去世，至死也未能侦破卡丽娜的谋杀案。

sentences.en: Detective Fleming met with Sarah and interviewed her at length.
sentences.zh: 弗莱明侦探与萨拉会面，并对她进行了长时间的讯问。

sentences.en: He found her very credible.
sentences.zh: 他发现她的证词非常可信。

sentences.en: Her allegations against Lieutenant Billy Fields didn't come as a total shock to those who knew him.
sentences.zh: 她对中尉比利·菲尔兹的指控，对于那些了解他的人来说并非完全是个震惊。

sentences.en: Billy Fields was renowned in Central City for being involved in, and seemingly leading, a drug ring.
sentences.zh: 比利·菲尔兹在中央城臭名昭著，他参与并似乎领导了一个贩毒团伙。

sentences.en: Rumours that he was involved in the Mullen case had been whispered throughout the town for years.
sentences.zh: 关于他卷入穆伦案的谣言在整个小镇已经私下流传了好几年。

sentences.en: In 1992, when the FBI became involved in the case, Fields abruptly retired from the Central City Police Department at the age of 49.
sentences.zh: 1992年，当联邦调查局介入此案时，菲尔兹在49岁时突然从中央城警察局退休。

sentences.en: This only fuelled local gossip about the case, though all he would say was, I knew the girl, I knew who she was, but that was the extent of it.
sentences.zh: 这更加助长了当地关于此案的流言蜚语，尽管他所能说的只有：我认识那个女孩，我知道她是谁，但事情仅此而已。

sentences.en: There were two individuals Sarah had seen assist Fields that she couldn't name.
sentences.zh: 萨拉曾看到有两个人协助过菲尔兹，但她叫不出他们的名字。

sentences.en: One played a smaller role and was already at Carina's apartment when Fields and his accomplice took her there.
sentences.zh: 其中一人扮演的角色较小，当菲尔兹和同伙把卡丽娜带到公寓时，他已经在那儿了。

sentences.en: Fleming had a theory about who this might be.
sentences.zh: 弗莱明对这人可能是谁有一个推测。

sentences.en: While going through the case file that Arnett had put together,
sentences.zh: 在翻阅阿内特整理的案卷时，

sentences.en: Fleming discovered a recorded police interview with a local man named Crandall Gibson.
sentences.zh: 弗莱明发现了一段警方对当地一名叫克兰德尔·吉布森的男子的录音讯问。

sentences.en: Apparently discussing Carina's murder, Gibson had told the officers, You can't get me without the other two.
sentences.zh: 吉布森显然在谈论卡丽娜的谋杀案时对警察说过：如果没有另外两个人，你们就抓不到我。

sentences.en: Fleming wondered whether Gibson was one of the people at Carina's apartment that night.
sentences.zh: 弗莱明不禁琢磨吉布森是否就是当晚在卡丽娜公寓里的其中一人。

sentences.en: As the recording wasn't authenticated and had been made prior to Fleming being assigned the case, he couldn't use it as evidence.
sentences.zh: 由于该录音未经鉴定，且是在弗莱明接手此案之前录制的，因此他不能将其用作证据。

sentences.en: Both Arnett and Gibson had since passed away and couldn't be questioned about it.
sentences.zh: 阿内特和吉布森此后均已去世，无法再就此事接受讯问。

sentences.en: The second unknown man had played a much larger role in helping Fields abduct Sarah, assault Carina and dispose of her body.
sentences.zh: 第二个身份不明的男子在协助菲尔兹绑架萨拉、袭击卡丽娜以及处理尸体方面扮演了重得多的角色。

sentences.en: Sarah didn't recall hearing his name, but his face and imposing physical presence were still crystal clear in her mind.
sentences.zh: 萨拉不记得听过他的名字，但他那张脸和魁梧的身材在她脑海中依然清晰无比。

sentences.en: Detective Fleming showed her a mugshot of a man who was a known accomplice of Fields.
sentences.zh: 弗莱明侦探给她看了一张男子的面部照片，此人是菲尔兹众所周知的同伙。

sentences.en: Now 43 years old, he had the same round, pudgy face, but framed by a full head of grey hair and a wiry goatee.
sentences.zh: 如今43岁的他依然长着那张圆圆胖胖的脸，但满头灰发，留着一撮硬邦邦的山羊胡。

sentences.en: Sarah recognised him right away as one of the main perpetrators.
sentences.zh: 萨拉一眼就认出他就是主要行凶者之一。

sentences.en: His name was Jeffrey Boyd.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫杰弗里·博伊德。

sentences.en: Boyd was already incarcerated at the Kentucky State Penitentiary for a variety of crimes, ranging from drug trafficking to tampering with evidence.
sentences.zh: 博伊德当时因涉及从贩毒到毁灭证据等各种罪行，已经被关押在肯塔基州立监狱中。

sentences.en: One of the other alleged attackers, Jimmy Kramer, had two prior convictions, one for sexual assault in 1984 and another for rape in 1988, but was now freely living his life.
sentences.zh: 另一名涉嫌袭击者吉米·克拉默曾有两次前科，一次是在1984年因性侵犯被判刑，另一次是在1988年因强奸被判刑，但如今他却逍遥法外、过着自由的生活。

sentences.en: As was Billy Fields.
sentences.zh: 比利·菲尔兹也是如此。

sentences.en: It turned out that some Central City residents had known Fields had a connection with Carina Mullen for years.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，一些中央城居民多年来一直知道菲尔兹与卡丽娜·穆伦有染。

sentences.en: Although Carina had been dating Jimmy Springer, she was also romantically involved with Fields.
sentences.zh: 尽管卡丽娜当时一直在与吉米·斯普林格交往，但她也与菲尔兹有浪漫关系。

sentences.en: Edna McGee Eaves lived in the same apartment complex as Carina.
sentences.zh: 埃德娜·麦吉·伊夫斯和卡丽娜住在同一个公寓大楼里。

sentences.en: Occasionally, the two women chatted when they crossed paths.
sentences.zh: 偶尔，这两个女人在偶遇时会闲聊几句。

sentences.en: Edna noticed Fields' police cruiser parked directly outside Carina's apartment on several occasions and was under the impression that they were dating.
sentences.zh: 埃德娜曾多次注意到菲尔兹的警车直接停在卡丽娜公寓外面，并认为他们在谈恋爱。

sentences.en: She had also seen Jeffrey Boyd and Jimmy Kramer at the apartment before.
sentences.zh: 她以前也曾在该公寓见过杰弗里·博伊德和吉米·克拉默。

sentences.en: At least two other witnesses came forward to say they saw Fields and Carina together on multiple occasions, including the site manager for the Hillwood Apartments.
sentences.zh: 至少还有另外两名目击者站出来表示，他们曾多次看到菲尔兹和卡丽娜在一起，其中包括希尔伍德公寓的现场经理。

sentences.en: One day, Fields approached him to request that he keep Carina as a tenant, even though it was her housemate Angela Smith who was on the lease.
sentences.zh: 有一天，菲尔兹找到他，要求让他继续把房子租给卡丽娜，尽管租约上写的是她的室友安吉拉·史密斯的名字。

sentences.en: Very quickly though, things seemed to sour between Fields and Carina.
sentences.zh: 不过，菲尔兹和卡丽娜之间的关系很快似乎就恶化了。

sentences.en: Edna McGee Eaves noticed that Carina had started to look increasingly upset.
sentences.zh: 埃德娜·麦吉·伊夫斯注意到卡丽娜开始显得越来越沮丧。

sentences.en: One day, she stopped to chat with Carina, who confessed that she thought she might be pregnant.
sentences.zh: 有一天，她停下来与卡丽娜闲聊，卡丽娜向她坦白说，她觉得自己可能怀孕了。

sentences.en: She'd told Fields that he was the father.
sentences.zh: 她告诉过菲尔兹他是孩子的父亲。

sentences.en: He wasn't happy about it.
sentences.zh: 对此他并不高兴。

sentences.en: On the night of Carina's murder, Edna noticed Carina's car backed right up to the curb with its boot open.
sentences.zh: 在卡丽娜遇害的那天晚上，埃德娜注意到卡丽娜的车紧紧倒车停在路边，后备箱开着。

sentences.en: Scanning her eyes around the parking lot, Edna realised Fields' police cruiser was there as well.
sentences.zh: 埃德娜环顾停车场，意识到菲尔兹的警车也在那里。

sentences.en: When news broke of Carina's murder the following day, Edna realised she might have seen something significant.
sentences.zh: 第二天卡丽娜遇害的消息传开后，埃德娜意识到自己可能看到了重要线索。

sentences.en: Too scared to come forward, given Fields himself was leading the investigation, she kept the knowledge to herself for years to come.
sentences.zh: 由于害怕出面（鉴于菲尔兹本人正在领导调查），她把这个秘密藏在心里多年。

sentences.en: Later stating,
sentences.zh: 后来她表述道：

sentences.en: My concern was,
sentences.zh: 我当时担心的是：

sentences.en: Who do I talk to?
sentences.zh: 我该跟谁谈谈？

sentences.en: Who do I go to?
sentences.zh: 我该去找谁？

sentences.en: What do I do?
sentences.zh: 我该怎么做？

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案卷》节目稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告以支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《案卷》继续为您提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: Fields had never disclosed just how close he was to Carina.
sentences.zh: 菲尔兹从未透露过他与卡丽娜的关系究竟有多亲密。

sentences.en: During the original investigation, it was his job to doorknock all of her neighbours and take statements from everyone in the building.
sentences.zh: 在最初的调查期间，他的工作是走访卡丽娜的所有邻居并记录大楼里每个人的供词。

sentences.en: Investigators theorised that he might have threatened them into keeping quiet about anything they might have seen or heard.
sentences.zh: 调查人员推测，他可能曾威胁过他们，让他们对任何看到或听到的事情守口如瓶。

sentences.en: Digging through official police documentation, detectives discovered a receipt from August 8,
sentences.zh: 通过翻阅官方警察档案，侦探们发现了一张1988年8月8日的收据，

sentences.en: 1988, it showed that Fields signed out 18 items of evidence from the Kentucky State Police Lab that related to Carina's murder, including her rape kit.
sentences.zh: 上面显示菲尔兹从肯塔基州警察实验室签领了18件与卡丽娜谋杀案有关的证据，其中包括她的强奸取证包。

sentences.en: None of the evidence had ever been examined because Central City Police hadn't requested testing, despite the fact that Jimmy Springer had already been tried.
sentences.zh: 这些证据从未得到过任何检验，因为中央城警察局根本没有要求进行检测，尽管吉米·斯普林格当时已经受审。

sentences.en: Moreover, Fields asked that the items be returned to him untested.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，菲尔兹还要求将这些未经检测的物品退还给他。

sentences.en: Asking for evidence that had not been examined by forensic technicians was highly unusual behaviour from an investigator.
sentences.zh: 要求索取未经法医技术人员检验的证据，这对于一名调查人员来说是极不寻常的行为。

sentences.en: The receipt was the final record in the chain of custody.
sentences.zh: 这张收据是证据保管链中的最后一份记录。

sentences.en: Detectives weren't sure where the evidence ended up after being signed out to Fields, but they suspected he destroyed it.
sentences.zh: 侦探们不确定这些证据在被签领给菲尔兹后最终流落何方，但他们怀疑是被他销毁了。

sentences.en: Despite multiple witnesses telling police Carina believed she was pregnant at the time of her death, nothing in her autopsy indicated this was the case.
sentences.zh: 尽管有多名目击者告诉警方，卡丽娜在遇害时认为自己怀孕了，但她尸检中的任何内容都未表明事实确实如此。

sentences.en: Investigators wondered if she merely suspected she was pregnant and never confirmed it.
sentences.zh: 调查人员怀疑她当时只是怀疑自己怀孕，但从未得到证实。

sentences.en: Whether Fields believed she was carrying his child or not, another motive soon emerged.
sentences.zh: 无论菲尔兹是否相信她怀着自己的骨肉，另一个动机很快就浮出水面。

sentences.en: While Carina was completing her community service by doing clerical work at Central City Police Station, she became friendly with an officer there named John Scott.
sentences.zh: 当卡丽娜在中央城警察局做文书工作来完成社区服务时，她和那里的一名叫约翰·斯科特的警官成了朋友。

sentences.en: The pair already knew each other through Scott's sisters, but working in close proximity brought them even closer together.
sentences.zh: 两人通过斯科特的姐姐们本来就相识，但近距离的工作让他们的关系更加密切。

sentences.en: Eventually, Carina felt comfortable enough to confide in Scott.
sentences.zh: 最终，卡丽娜感到足够安心，便向斯科特吐露了心声。

sentences.en: Two days before her death, she told him that her boyfriend, Jimmy Springer, was involved in a drug ring and was also trafficking stolen property interstate.
sentences.zh: 在她遇害前两天，她告诉他，她的男友吉米·斯普林格卷入了一个贩毒团伙，并且还在跨州贩运赃物。

sentences.en: He was undertaking these criminal activities alongside Geoffrey Boyd and his long-time friend, Dale Duncan.
sentences.zh: 他一直在与杰弗里·博伊德以及他多年的好友戴尔·邓肯一起从事这些犯罪活动。

sentences.en: Carina agreed to file an official report about these allegations, which Scott recorded for her.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜同意就这些指控提交一份正式报告，斯科特为她作了记录。

sentences.en: After receiving the report, Officer Scott told his colleague,
sentences.zh: 收到报告后，斯科特警官将此事告诉了他的同事——

sentences.en: Lieutenant Billy Fields, about it.
sentences.zh: 中尉比利·菲尔兹。

sentences.en: What neither Scott nor Carina knew was that Fields was commonly understood to be the mastermind behind the drug and theft ring.
sentences.zh: 斯科特和卡丽娜都不知道的是，大家普遍认为菲尔兹就是这起贩毒和盗窃团伙的幕后主使。

sentences.en: Detectives believed that he murdered Carina out of revenge and to keep her from speaking further about the matter.
sentences.zh: 侦探们相信，他谋杀卡丽娜是为了报复，也是为了阻止她进一步谈论此事。

sentences.en: Investigators tracked down more witnesses with incriminating stories to tell.
sentences.zh: 调查人员又追踪到了更多能提供涉案线索的目击者。

sentences.en: A local man named Jimmy Gunn saw Geoffrey Boyd approach Carina at a diner the day before she was killed.
sentences.zh: 当地一名叫吉米·冈恩的男子看到杰弗里·博伊德在卡丽娜遇害前一天在一家小餐馆里走向她。

sentences.en: Boyd threatened Carina with a gun and stated,
sentences.zh: 博伊德用枪威胁卡丽娜并说道：

sentences.en: Bitch, you'll die tonight.
sentences.zh: 贱人，你今晚就得死。

sentences.en: Jimmy immediately phoned the police station.
sentences.zh: 吉米随即给警察局打了电话。

sentences.en: Billy Fields took his call and said he'd attend to the matter.
sentences.zh: 比利·菲尔兹接了电话，并说他会处理这件事。

sentences.en: As the police station was just a couple of hundred yards from the diner,
sentences.zh: 由于警察局离这家小餐馆只有几百码远，

sentences.en: Jimmy expected the officer would arrive quickly.
sentences.zh: 吉米期望警官能迅速赶到。

sentences.en: But minutes passed and there was no sign of him.
sentences.zh: 但几分钟过去了，依然不见他的踪影。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Boyd moved his car and then his mother turned up at the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，博伊德把车挪开，接着他母亲来到了餐馆。

sentences.en: Jimmy saw Boyd pass something over to her, which Jimmy believed to be his firearm.
sentences.zh: 吉米看到博伊德递给她一样东西，吉米认为那是他的枪支。

sentences.en: When Fields finally arrived at the scene almost 20 minutes later,
sentences.zh: 当菲尔兹在将近20分钟后终于赶到现场时，

sentences.en: Boyd held up his hands as though to prove that he was unarmed.
sentences.zh: 博伊德举起双手，仿佛在证明自己没有携带武器。

sentences.en: Another witness came forward to say he saw Fields and Boyd in the early hours of October 2, 1987.
sentences.zh: 另一位目击者站出来称，他看到菲尔兹和博伊德在1987年10月2日的凌晨时分在一起。

sentences.en: The pair were walking along Legion Drive, the same street near where Carina Mullin's car was dumped with her corpse inside.
sentences.zh: 两人正沿着勒容大道步行，这条街正是卡丽娜·穆伦的尸车被遗弃的附近街道。

sentences.en: Mike Phillips, who had been a Central City Police officer back in 1987, also reportedly saw Boyd walking near Legion Drive at 3am that same day,
sentences.zh: 据报道，曾在1987年担任中央城警察的迈克·菲利普斯，也在当天凌晨3点左右看到博伊德在勒容大道附近行走，

sentences.en: six hours before Carina's body was found.
sentences.zh: 那是卡丽娜的尸体被发现的六个小时前。

sentences.en: Armed with this new evidence, Detective Damon Fleming of Kentucky State Police began making arrests on November 2, 2006.
sentences.zh: 凭借这些新证据，肯塔基州警察局的侦探达蒙·弗莱明于2006年11月2日开始实施逮捕。

sentences.en: Retired Central City Police officer Billy Fields, now 63 years old, was charged with first-degree rape, kidnapping, murder, and tampering with evidence.
sentences.zh: 退休中央城警察局警官比利·菲尔兹当时63岁，被指控犯有一级强奸罪、绑架罪、谋杀罪以及毁灭证据罪。

sentences.en: He was also charged with one count of sodomy for his assault of eyewitness Sarah.
sentences.zh: 他还因对目击者萨拉实施人身攻击而被控一项鸡奸罪。

sentences.en: His accomplice, Jimmy Kramer, aged 37, was also arrested and charged with first-degree rape, kidnapping, and murder.
sentences.zh: 他的同伙吉米·克拉默现年37岁，也被捕并被控犯有一级强奸罪、绑架罪和谋杀罪。

sentences.en: He spoke out against the arrest, telling reporters,
sentences.zh: 他公开反对逮捕行动，对记者说道：

sentences.en: I hope they do get whoever did this because they do need to be put away, but I know I didn't have anything to do with it and don't know nothing about it.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们能抓到真正干这事的人，因为他们确实该被关起来，但我知道我跟这事毫无关系，也对此一无所知。

sentences.en: The third individual arrested was 40-year-old Angela Smith, Carina's former housemate.
sentences.zh: 被捕的第三个人是40岁的安吉拉·史密斯，也就是卡丽娜的前室友。

sentences.en: Because she had been present during the rape and murder of Carina, yet never tried to intervene, she was charged with complicity to rape, kidnapping, and murder.
sentences.zh: 由于她在卡丽娜遭受强奸和谋杀时身在现场却从未试图干预，她被指控犯有强奸、绑架和谋杀共犯罪。

sentences.en: Jeffrey Boyd was already serving time for drug trafficking and evidence tampering.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里·博伊德当时已因贩毒和毁灭证据在服刑。

sentences.en: He was charged the following day with rape, kidnapping, and murder.
sentences.zh: 他在第二天被增控强奸、绑架和谋杀罪。

sentences.en: As Jimmy Springer had already been tried and acquitted of Carina's murder in 1988, he couldn't be charged with killing her again.
sentences.zh: 由于吉米·斯普林格在1988年就已经受审并被判卡丽娜谋杀罪名不成立，因此他不能再次被控杀害卡丽娜。

sentences.en: Instead, he was charged with complicity to rape, kidnapping, and sodomy.
sentences.zh: 取而代之的是，他被指控犯有强奸、绑架和鸡奸共犯罪。

sentences.en: Carina's family were aware that arrests were imminent.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜的家人意识到逮捕行动即将来临。

sentences.en: The apprehending of Fields, Kramer, and Smith coincided with Patricia Mullins' birthday, but she had passed away one month prior.
sentences.zh: 逮捕菲尔兹、克拉默和史密斯的行动正好赶上帕特里夏·穆伦的生日，但她已经在一个月前去世了。

sentences.en: The Mullins were devastated to learn that the man they'd believed was helping to find their daughter's killer was actually the culprit.
sentences.zh: 穆伦一家震惊地得知，他们一直以为在帮忙寻找女儿凶手的人竟然就是罪魁祸首。

sentences.en: During the initial investigation,
sentences.zh: 在最初的调查期间，

sentences.en: Fields visited the family home and sat at the kitchen table, offering comfort and commiserations.
sentences.zh: 菲尔兹曾造访他们家，坐在厨房桌旁，给予他们安慰和慰问。

sentences.en: Once, he even took Claude Mullin out to look for clues together.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他甚至带着克劳德·穆伦一起出去寻找线索。

sentences.en: Still, they were also relieved that arrests had finally been made.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他们也为终于实施了逮捕而感到如释重负。

sentences.en: Claude told the messenger inquirer,
sentences.zh: 克劳德告诉《信使问询报》：

sentences.en: Carina's daughter, Stephanie, who was just a toddler when her mother died, was now 21 years old.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜的女儿斯蒂芬妮在母亲去世时还只是个幼儿，如今已经21岁了。

sentences.en: She had just learned that she was pregnant when the news of the arrests broke.
sentences.zh: 就在逮捕消息传出时，她刚刚得知自己怀孕了。

sentences.en: Carina's sister, Heather, told the messenger inquirer how difficult Stephanie's childhood had been, stating,
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜的姐姐希瑟向《信使问询报》诉说了斯蒂芬妮的童年是多么艰难，她说道：

sentences.en: It's bad enough to grow up without knowing your parents, but to get to know your parents in this way, it distorts the person she knows that her mum was.
sentences.zh: 在不知道父母是谁的情况下长大已经够糟糕了，而以这种方式去了解你的父母，则会扭曲她心中母亲原本的形象。

sentences.en: Watching her grow up and having to hear all these things about her mother, that was one of the worst things.
sentences.zh: 看着她长大并不得不听取所有这些关于她母亲的言论，这是最糟糕的事情之一。

sentences.en: The following month, a grand jury indicted all defendants on the charges that had been laid.
sentences.zh: 次月，大陪审团对所有被告提起了既定指控。

sentences.en: The trial was initially slated to commence in November 2007, but was postponed so it could be moved to a court in another part of the state.
sentences.zh: 审判最初定于2007年11月开始，但为了移交至该州另一地区的法院审理而延期了。

sentences.en: Carina's murder and the individuals charged for it were so notorious in Muhlenberg County that there were fears the defendants wouldn't receive a fair trial there.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜的谋杀案以及被指控的涉案人员在穆伦堡县可谓人尽皆知，因此人们担心被告在那里无法获得公正的审判。

sentences.en: Before the case finally began, the three charges against Angela Smith were dropped in exchange for testifying against Fields, Boyd and Kramer.
sentences.zh: 在案件正式开庭前，针对安吉拉·史密斯的三个指控被撤销，作为交换，她将出庭指证菲尔兹、博伊德和克拉默。

sentences.en: She would instead face a single count of perjury for the false testimony she gave at Jimmy Springer's trial in 1988.
sentences.zh: 她将仅因1988年在吉米·斯普林格审判中作出的虚假证词而面临一项伪证罪指控。

sentences.en: She would be tried solo.
sentences.zh: 她将单独受审。

sentences.en: Springer would also face courts separate from the others.
sentences.zh: 斯普林格也将面临与其他被告分开的审判。

sentences.en: On April 21 2009,
Billy Fields, Jimmy Kramer and Geoffrey Boyd all filed into court, handcuffed and dressed in orange prison jumpsuits.
sentences.zh: 比利·菲尔兹、吉米·克雷默和杰弗里·博伊德排队走进法庭，他们戴着手铐，身穿橙色囚服。

sentences.en: Now bespectacled and balding with a white ring of hair,
sentences.zh: 如今他戴着眼镜，顶着地中海发型，周围围着一圈白发，

sentences.en: Fields struck a very different figure than the imposing lawman he'd been back in the late 80s.
sentences.zh: 菲尔兹的形象与他80年代末当执法人员时的威风凛凛大相径庭。

sentences.en: Eyewitness Sarah took the stand and told the court about what she and Carina endured at the hands of the defendants more than 20 years earlier.
sentences.zh: 目击者莎拉出庭作证，向法庭讲述了她和卡丽娜在20多年前遭受被告虐待的经历。

sentences.en: The defendants' attorneys subjected her to a fierce cross-examination.
sentences.zh: 被告律师对她进行了严厉的盘问。

sentences.en: They demanded to know why she hadn't spoken up earlier, especially when her own family members became involved with Jimmy Kramer.
sentences.zh: 他们质问她为什么没有早点站出来，尤其是当她自己的家人与吉米·克雷默产生交集的时候。

sentences.en: One cast a doubt on her recollections by suggesting that if she really witnessed Carina's murder, then those responsible wouldn't have let her live to tell the tale.
sentences.zh: 其中一人对她的记忆提出质疑，暗示如果她真的目睹了卡丽娜被谋杀，凶手是不可能让她活下来把事情说出去的。

sentences.en: He theorised Sarah cobbled her story together from town gossip.
sentences.zh: 他推测莎拉的故事是从镇上的流言蜚语中拼凑出来的。

sentences.en: But Sarah stood firm.
sentences.zh: 但莎拉立场坚定。

sentences.en: Angela Smith had turned state's witness for the prosecution and explained how she'd lied during the original murder trial.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉·史密斯已转为控方污点证人，她解释了自己在最初的谋杀案审判中是如何撒谎的。

sentences.en: Angela confirmed that she and Carina had gone out to a bar with Jeffrey Boyd on the night in question, prior to heading back to their apartment and the assault on Carina beginning.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉证实，在出事当晚，她和卡丽娜曾与杰弗里·博伊德一起去酒吧，之后才返回公寓，随后卡丽娜便遭到了袭击。

sentences.en: Billy Fields took the stand to testify in his own defence.
sentences.zh: 比利·菲尔兹出庭为自己辩护。

sentences.en: He'd only worked two or three murder cases in his entire policing career, but still claimed his memory of the Carina Mullen case was vague.
sentences.zh: 在他的整个警察生涯中，他只经手过两三起谋杀案，但他仍坚称自己对卡丽娜·穆伦案的记忆已经模糊了。

sentences.en: He detailed how he scoured Carina's bedroom for evidence and collected her hair for testing, though he couldn't recall finding any men's jeans or underwear in the room.
sentences.zh: 他详细描述了自己在卡丽娜的卧室里搜寻证据并收集毛发进行检测的过程，尽管他记不起在房间里是否找到过男士牛仔裤或内衣。

sentences.en: Fields was shown crime scene photos of these items at the scene, with his legs visible in the background.
sentences.zh: 法庭向菲尔兹展示了案发现场这些物品的照片，照片背景中还能看到他的双腿。

sentences.en: He insisted he only vaguely knew Carina through her community service work.
sentences.zh: 他坚称自己只是通过社区服务活动隐约认识卡丽娜。

sentences.en: He was never involved with her and certainly hadn't been to her home.
sentences.zh: 他从未与她有过瓜葛，更绝对没有去过她的家。

sentences.en: Eyewitnesses who saw Fields' police cruiser parked outside Carina's residence multiple times gave evidence contradicting his claiMs.
sentences.zh: 多名目击者曾看到菲尔兹的警车停在卡丽娜住所外，他们的证词驳斥了他的说辞。

sentences.en: None of the other defendants testified.
sentences.zh: 其他被告均未出庭作证。

sentences.en: A former inmate who'd been incarcerated alongside Jimmy Kramer while he was awaiting trial gave evidence that Kramer showed him photos of Carina.
sentences.zh: 一名曾与吉米·克雷默在候审期间关押在同一监狱的前囚犯作证称，克雷默曾向他展示卡丽娜的照片。

sentences.en: Kramer obtained the photographs during the discovery phase of the trial and they depicted her naked corpse in the car boot as well as during her autopsy.
sentences.zh: 克雷默是在审判的证据开示阶段获得这些照片的，照片中显示了她裸露的尸体在汽车后备箱里以及尸检时的情景。

sentences.en: Kramer seemed proud of the images and bragged to his fellow inmate, look what we'd done to her.
sentences.zh: 克雷默似乎对这些照片感到自豪，并向同监犯人格外炫耀，看看我们对她做了什么。

sentences.en: After a day's deliberation, the jury found the three defendants guilty on all counts.
sentences.zh: 经过一天的商议，陪审团裁定三名被告所有罪名成立。

sentences.en: Jimmy Kramer received three 20-year sentences to be served consecutively for a total of 60 years.
sentences.zh: 吉米·克雷默被判处三项20年有期徒刑，数罪并罚，共计60年。

sentences.en: Billy Fields and Jeffrey Boyd were sentenced to life in prison with no possibility of parole.
sentences.zh: 比利·菲尔兹和杰弗里·博伊德被判处无期徒刑，不得假释。

sentences.en: Carina's daughter Stephanie shared her relief as well as her sorrow, saying, We never thought this day would come.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜的女儿斯蒂芬妮表达了她的如释重负与悲伤，她说：“我们从没想过这一天会到来。”

sentences.en: I didn't have a normal life because of them.
sentences.zh: 因为他们，我没有过上正常的生活。

sentences.en: My life was watching the two people I cared most about, my grandparents, cry every day.
sentences.zh: 我的生活就是看着我最在乎的两个人——我的外祖父母每天哭泣。

sentences.en: In 2011, Fields, Boyd and Kramer all appealed their convictions, but were denied.
sentences.zh: 2011年，菲尔兹、博伊德和克雷默均对定罪提起上诉，但被驳回。

sentences.en: The details of what happened to Carina's boyfriend,
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜的男友

sentences.en: Jimmy Springer, are unclear.
sentences.zh: 吉米·斯普林格的下落尚不明确。

sentences.en: Although he was to be tried separate for complicity to rape and kidnapping,
sentences.zh: 尽管他本应因涉嫌强奸和绑架共犯接受单独审判，

sentences.en: Case File was unable to find any record of relevant court cases.
sentences.zh: 档案室未能找到任何相关法庭案件的记录。

sentences.en: Springer has since served sentences for drug-related charges and was incarcerated for trafficking methamphetamine in 2020.
sentences.zh: 此后，斯普林格曾因涉毒指控服刑，并于2020年因贩卖冰毒再次入狱。

sentences.en: Angela Smith pleaded guilty to perjury and was given a five-year suspended sentence.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉·史密斯对伪证罪认罪，被判处五年缓刑。

sentences.en: In the years since Carina was murdered, those who knew and loved her have endeavoured to keep her memory alive.
sentences.zh: 在卡丽娜遇害后的这些年里，那些认识并爱着她的人一直努力让她的记忆长存。

sentences.en: They remember Carina by her nickname, Rennie, her long, wavy, dark blonde hair, blue eyes and white smile.
sentences.zh: 人们通过她的昵称“雷妮”、她长长的波浪形深金黄色头发、蓝色的眼睛和灿烂的笑容来缅怀卡丽娜。

sentences.en: Happy and strong-willed, she loved unicorns, teddy bears and the 1984 film, Footloose.
sentences.zh: 她快乐而坚强，喜欢独角兽、泰迪熊和1984年的电影《浑身是劲》。

sentences.en: If she were alive today,
sentences.zh: 如果她今天还活着，

sentences.en: Carina would now be a grandmother.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜现在应该已经是个祖母了。

sentences.en: At the time of his daughter's murder trial,
sentences.zh: 在女儿的谋杀案审判期间，

sentences.en: Claude Mullins stated,
sentences.zh: 克劳德·穆林斯表示：

sentences.en: We'll stick with it until it's done, no matter how long it takes.
sentences.zh: “不管花多长时间，我们都会坚持到底，直到真相大白。”

sentences.en: That's what I told them 20 years ago.
sentences.zh: 这就是我20年前对他们说过的话。

sentences.en: I mean it then, and I mean it now.
sentences.zh: 我当时是认真的，现在也一样。

sentences.en: In the years following the guilty verdict,
sentences.zh: 在罪名成立后的几年里，

sentences.en: Claude Mullin found it easier to visit Carina's gravesite, knowing justice had finally been served.
sentences.zh: 克劳德·穆林觉得去拜访卡丽娜的墓地变得容易多了，因为他知道正义终于得到了伸张。

sentences.en: He was initially heartbroken that his wife Patricia wasn't there to see it, remarking,
sentences.zh: 最初，他的妻子帕特里夏未能亲眼见证这一刻，这让他心碎不已，他感慨道：

sentences.en: Patricia was buried alongside her daughter in the open, grassy fields of Sunnyside Cemetery just outside of Central City.
sentences.zh: 帕特里夏被安葬在中央市郊外阳光公墓开阔的草地里，紧挨着她的女儿。

sentences.en: Claude was laid to rest alongside his wife and daughter.
sentences.zh: 克劳德长眠于妻子和女儿身旁。

sentences.en: He would remain forever close to Carina, just as he had been in life.
sentences.zh: 他将永远陪伴在卡丽娜身边，就像生前一样。

sentences.en: Carina had loved her family, especially her father.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜深爱着她的家人，尤其是她的父亲。

sentences.en: On special occasions,
sentences.zh: 在特殊的日子里，

sentences.en: Carina would give her father a single red rose and he would give her one in return.
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜会送给父亲一朵红玫瑰，而父亲也会回赠她一朵。

sentences.en: Carina's sister, Heather, quote,
sentences.zh: 卡丽娜的姐姐希瑟说道：

sentences.en: The biggest thing I remember was that Carina had the brightest personality of any person we'll ever meet.
sentences.zh: “我印象最深的是，在我们见过的所有人中，卡丽娜的性格是最开朗的。”

sentences.en: She had a lot of energy.
sentences.zh: 她充满活力。

sentences.en: She loved to laugh and she loved to be around her family.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢笑，喜欢和家人待在一起。

sentences.en: It was the best thing about her.
sentences.zh: 这是她身上最美好的品质。
